calculation.physics: Pandapower AC Newton-Raphson incremental import search
calculation.n0: maximum incremental demand satisfying convergence, voltage and thermal limits
calculation.n1: minimum capacity across mocked incident-line outages

assumptions.line_model: synthetic series impedance and thermal rating; shunt charging omitted because compensation is unknown
assumptions.loads: deterministic synthetic 15-40 MW nodal base loads before scenario scaling
assumptions.security: incident synthetic circuit outages only; not the 50Hertz contingency list
assumptions.flexibility: representative interruptibility and four-hour BESS policy

confidence.interpretation: Distribution across representative mocked operating conditions; not statistical operator confidence.

hourly_ensemble.dominant_uncertainty: Synthetic operating conditions are not time-aligned operator telemetry.
